name: Multi-frame Depth Estimation via Volume Rendering
definition: A method to project occupancy fields to multi-camera depth maps by casting rays, sampling points in a parameterized coordinate system, and computing depth using accumulated weights and densities.
summary: Multi-frame Depth Estimation via Volume Rendering projects 3D occupancy fields into depth maps by sampling uniformly in a parameterized space to ensure balanced point distribution for optimization in large-scale scenes.
